contract: A23-32 '얻은 순': data.ItemSeq[item id | PotionHP | PotionMP] and data.WeaponSeq[tier] hold the number of the last gain from the one counter data.ItemSeqNext (bigger = more recent, 0 = an old save / never). Gains: LootService.addItem (drops, the first-scroll grant, DebugGive), and a rise of the mirrored HPPotionCount / MPPotionCount or a new WeaponOwnedMask bit from any service (shop, quests, story, drops); using / selling and the values a save loads with are not gains. Config.SanitizeItemSeq (DataService.fillDefaults) keeps only known keys and positive integers, a dense weapon array, and a counter never below a used number. The owner's Inventory payload carries ItemSeq and WeaponSeq; a rejoin keeps them.
limitations: Offline doubles: Players / attributes (changed signals fire on a real change, synchronously), a PlayerService double (data rows, SetStat mirror), DataService's load is stood in by the defaults fill + Config.SanitizeItemSeq (the fillDefaults call is checked statically). The bag window's sort (BB7, client) is the 게임성 개발 session's and is not certified here.
